lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters posterior to the gills. The mid-lateral flank displays approximately five distinct columns, with the central columns containing four to five primary local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the high-luminance blobs to create a rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs contained within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered near the anterior and basal margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-luminance pixel concentration located at the distal tip of the pectoral fin, creating a white terminal edge contrast.
